description: Source file implementing Vulkan command buffer and command pool classes, including methods for command buffer management, binding pipelines/descriptors, inserting barriers, copying buffers/images, and query operations.

classes.name: CommandBuffer
classes.description: Class managing Vulkan command buffer recording, binding, barriers, copying, and submission.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: Class managing Vulkan command pool creation, command buffer allocation, and reset.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts recording commands into the command buffer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends recording commands into the command buffer.

methods.name: bind_pipeline
methods.description: Binds a compute pipeline to the command buffer.

methods.name: bind_descriptors
methods.description: Binds descriptor sets to the command buffer.

methods.name: insert_barrier
methods.description: Inserts a pipeline barrier for synchronization.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from one buffer to another.

methods.name: copy_texture_to_texture
methods.description: Copies data from one texture to another.

methods.name: copy_texture_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from a texture to a buffer.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_texture
methods.description: Copies data from a buffer to a texture.

methods.name: write_timestamp
methods.description: Writes a timestamp to a query pool.

methods.name: reset_querypool
methods.description: Resets a range of queries in a query pool.

methods.name: get_submit_handle
methods.description: Returns the handle for submitting the command buffer.

methods.name: CommandPool
methods.description: Manages Vulkan command pool creation, command buffer allocation, and reset.

methods.name: get_new_cmd
methods.description: Allocates a new command buffer from the pool.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets the command pool and clears allocated command buffers.

methods.name: allocate_new_batch
methods.description: Allocates a batch of new command buffers.
